title: The junction between the compartments gates cortical output

statements.text: A junction between the apical and basal compartments acts as a gate. In the conscious state the gate is open and signals reach higher-order thalamus, which projects back to the cortex and keeps the coupling. In the unconscious state the neurons are decoupled and activity no longer spreads through the thalamo-cortical system.

sources.quote: Between the two compartments, there is a junction (nexus point) that acts like a gate and controls the coupling between them.
In the conscious state, the gate within the pyramidal cells is open
